name: MAPTA
description: UCL research agent: a gpt-5 main agent directs sandbox and validator agents against web targets
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

techniques.comment: KQL hunt: Indicator sweep with the agentic watchlist; KQL hunt: MAPTA running on a host you monitor; Sigma: MAPTA Run Log, Usage or Sandbox Script Files Written; Sigma: MAPTA Sandbox Python Runner; YARA: MAPTA_Source
